dev-s068a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Cinder is a production endpoint, owned by team harbor
Priya Raman (staff id u62935) leads team harbor
Samuel Oyelaran (staff id u86038) leads team summit

timeline.text: Change request CR-9857 to disable the classifier for deploy 2940 on Project Cinder is approved by Samuel Oyelaran
Deploy 2940 turns the safety classifier off on Project Cinder (production)
Monitoring shows Project Cinder serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 2940 turned the classifier off on Project Cinder, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team harbor (CR-9857 was approved by Samuel Oyelaran, who doesn't lead team harbor).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-9857 was approved by the lead of another team.

chain.says: Deploy 2940's endpoint is the one in the ownership record
The owning team is the team in the org chart
CR-9857's approver is not the owning team's lead
